notes: Fixes the six known gaps: collections are in the backup and stay put when a show is moved or renamed; openings/endings found by sound can be skipped on the TV too; with several profiles the Plex import goes into the profile that started it and nobody's place is lost; Chromecast tries a refused stream again as a live stream and leaves Windows' mDNS port alone; 'Plays on the TV?' warns about file types CastApp TV can't open (Blu-ray .m2ts, WMV, Ogg video) and offers a TV copy; CastApp TV gets the exact sound track.
